articles.title: Model 1 and Grech Motors Launch $10,000 Retail Rebate on 2026 GM40 Freightliner
articles.mainIdea: Model 1 and Grech Motors Launch $10,000 Retail Rebate on 2026 GM40 Freightliner
articles.summary: GlobeNewswire: Model 1 and Grech Motors Launch $10,000 Retail Rebate on 2026 GM40 Freightliner. INDIANAPOLIS, April 01, 2026 (GLOBE NEWSWIRE) -- Model 1 Commercial Vehicles and Grech Motors today announced a limited-time $10,000 retail rebate on all new 2026 Grech Motors GM40 Freightliner shuttle buses. Available now through April 30, 2026, the rebate applies to eligible units available through Model 1—an authorized Grech Motors dealer—across its nationwide locations, including in-stock inventory.
